correctness.rationale: Every quadrangle determines a unique Baer subplane; uniform incidence counts and inclusion-exclusion prove the sharp four-point criterion, while five positives force a unique quadrangle-containing subplane and defeat the one-negative trace. A complete 32-leaf witness and two independently implemented finite recurrences prove Littlestone dimension 5. The rank-four paving matroid exchange proof and matroid shellability imply the sphere-wedge homotopy with 4740 top spheres.
